calculation.formula: SUM(IF [event_timestamp] >= [Parameters].[Start Date] AND [event_timestamp] <= [Parameters].[End Date] AND ([Parameters].[Platform Filter] = "All" OR [platform] = [Parameters].[Platform Filter]) AND ([Parameters].[Program Type Quick Filter] = "All" OR [program_type] = [Parameters].[Program Type Quick Filter]) AND ([Parameters].[Country Filter] = "All" OR [country] = [Parameters].[Country Filter]) THEN [arr] END)
